tur: Everyday objects tell their own life story, second person, with verified history (stick-figure animation)
ozet: Each film speaks to the viewer as an everyday object ("You were born in a mine…"): where it came from, who used it, how it changed the world, and one true surprising fact at the end. Adult nostalgia tone.
kurallar: Only verifiable history; dates and names must be well known. If unsure, write "around" or leave it out.
Second person narration: "You were born…". Warm, nostalgic, slightly funny; never childish.
No brand logos; no real people speaking.
yazim: 6 scenes, 70-100 words, vertical Shorts. Birth, discovery, first owner, long life, one true fact, closing question about the next object.

ogrenci.kim: A student who owns the object.
